name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Senior Customer Success & Account Manager | SaaS Adoption, Retention & Expansion
summary: Customer success and account management professional with 15+ years in SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments, driving product adoption, retention, and expansion across a book of business. Retained all but one of 15-20 reseller partners at Birdeye (~94%), managed a high-value account portfolio at Wix while leading a team of 20 (later 8), and advised C-suite buyers on operational system design at Accelo, a work-management and professional-services automation platform. I pair the relationship with technical depth: I configure CRMs and build integrations myself, so I can talk configuration trade-offs, not just outcomes.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of B2B clients, running discovery to align on goals, success metrics, and a plan to reach them.
Drive clients to their goals on complex SaaS platforms, and identify expansion opportunities by scoping complementary services aligned to their objectives.
Report performance on a regular cadence with dashboards and strategic recommendations, tracking adoption and outcomes in GA4, Power BI, and CRM analytics.
Architect CRM and automation systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, and build integrations with webhooks and custom code steps in Zapier, Make, and n8n.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder accounts, leading QBRs that translated ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion data into optimization recommendations.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Partner Success & Retention (Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding)
bullets: Onboarded and managed a book of 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to communicate product value.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to spot adoption gaps early and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Represented the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering, sharing structured, prioritized feedback that informed the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end, covering performance reporting and cross-team communication, and led the sales team while carrying my own book.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month as primary strategic contact, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), overseeing scope and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Drove process improvements for a new vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, including sales training for tenured account executives.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Advised C-suite buyers at agencies and professional-services firms as a trusted advisor on CRM adoption and operational system design, aligned to their growth stage and team structure.
Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled; averaged ~$17,750/month in implementation and services bookings (~$213K annualized).
Guided onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations alongside implementation teams, escalating account risk early.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
